id: \rWulfric is ten times harder than me.
en: \rWulfric is ten times harder than me.
it: \rEdel è dieci volte più forte di me.

id: \rI guess you might win.
en: \rI guess you might win.
it: \rMagari vinci pure.

id: \rWulfric has a secret weapon.
en: \rWulfric has a secret weapon.
it: \rEdel ha un'arma segreta.

id: \rIf he thinks you're strong enough he will show you that power.
en: \rIf he thinks you're strong enough he will show you that power.
it: \rSe pensa che tu sia abbastanza forte, ti mostrerà quel potere.

id: \bI'm going all out.
en: \bI'm going all out.
it: \bDarò il massimo.

id: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bGran bella lotta. Buona fortuna con il resto.

id: \bWulfric: Oh. A Trainer, is it? Let's see if you'll give me a challenge.
en: \bWulfric: Oh. A Trainer, is it? Let's see if you'll give me a challenge.
it: \bEdel: Oh. Un Allenatore, eh? Vediamo se sarai una vera sfida.

id: \bWulfric: You have potential, but you aren't good enough yet. You seem to have forgotten something important between you and your Pokémon.
en: \bWulfric: You have potential, but you aren't good enough yet. You seem to have forgotten something important between you and your Pokémon.
it: \bEdel: Hai del potenziale, ma non sei ancora abbastanza bravo. Sembra che tu abbia dimenticato qualcosa di importante tra te e i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bTry searching your soul for the answer. You know... I always find the woods to the south a calming place.
en: \bTry searching your soul for the answer. You know... I always find the woods to the south a calming place.
it: \bProva a cercare la risposta dentro di te. Sai... io trovo sempre rilassante il bosco a sud.

id: \bWulfric: So, you came back. Did you find your answer? Show me what you've learned.
en: \bWulfric: So, you came back. Did you find your answer? Show me what you've learned.
it: \bEdel: Allora sei tornato. Hai trovato la tua risposta? Mostrami cosa hai imparato.

id: \bWulfric: You've done very well. I admit that you're a talented and strong Trainer. Here, you earned the Iceberg Badge.
en: \bWulfric: You've done very well. I admit that you're a talented and strong Trainer. Here, you earned the Iceberg Badge.
it: \bEdel: Sei stato bravissimo. Ammetto che sei un Allenatore forte e di talento. Ecco, ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Iceberg.

id: \bHere, have this TM too.
en: \bHere, have this TM too.
it: \bEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \bTM120 contains Icicle Crash. It has a chance to flinch.
en: \bTM120 contains Icicle Crash. It has a chance to flinch.
it: \bLa MT120 contiene Scagliagelo. Può far tentennare il bersaglio.

id: \bYou've earned this as well. Use it with pride.
en: \bYou've earned this as well. Use it with pride.
it: \bTi sei guadagnato anche questo. Usalo con orgoglio.

id: \bWulfric: I wish you luck at the league.
en: \bWulfric: I wish you luck at the league.
it: \bEdel: Ti auguro buona fortuna alla Lega.

id: \bWulfric uses Ice type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Fire, Fighting, Rock, and Steel types.
en: \bWulfric uses Ice type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Fire, Fighting, Rock, and Steel types.
it: \bEdel usa Pokémon di tipo Ghiaccio. Sono deboli contro i tipi Fuoco, Lotta, Roccia e Acciaio.

id: \bThey are strong against Dragon, Flying, Grass, and Ground. They are resistant to only Ice.
en: \bThey are strong against Dragon, Flying, Grass, and Ground. They are resistant to only Ice.
it: \bSono forti contro Drago, Volante, Erba e Terra. Resistono soltanto al Ghiaccio.

id: \bI'm not cold...
en: \bI'm not cold...
it: \bNon ho freddo...

id: \bI'm warm now.
en: \bI'm warm now.
it: \bOra sto al caldo.
